provenance: PUBLISHED REPORTS, not registry-posted results. Bibliographic detail and abstracts ACCORDING TO PUBMED, retrieved 2026-08-19. This is the first literature-limb extraction in this corpus and is treated as a method proof.
rules_followed: Every cell records the QUOTE it came from and WHERE in the source.
NOTHING is computed from another cell. A percentage is not turned into a count and a total is not split into arms.
A cell the source does not state is recorded NOT_STATED_IN_THE_SOURCE_READ with the reason, never derived.

the_claim_this_refuted.what_I_said: Three trials register the identical primary verbatim, 'Recurrence rate at 18 months', all against placebo -- a k=3 pool blocked by nothing except the registry's silence.
the_claim_this_refuted.what_is_true: The registered TITLES match and the TRIALS do not. NCT00128453 is ICAP, a FIRST-ATTACK acute pericarditis trial whose published primary is 'incessant OR recurrent pericarditis'. NCT00128414 is CORP, a FIRST-RECURRENCE trial. NCT00235079 is CORP-2, a MULTIPLE-RECURRENCE trial. Three disease stages, and the registry's outcome-title field carries none of that.
the_claim_this_refuted.the_shape: Exact title matching was already labelled a LOWER BOUND -- it misses trials measuring one thing under different names. This is the other direction: a FALSE POSITIVE, three trials measuring different things under one name. REGISTERED TITLES ARE NOT ESTIMANDS, because the estimand includes the population and the title does not.
the_claim_this_refuted.found_by: reading the published reports, which is what the literature limb is for

population_as_the_paper_states_it.quote: 120 patients with a first recurrence of pericarditis

comparator_as_the_paper_states_it.quote: In addition to conventional treatment, patients were randomly assigned to receive either placebo or colchicine

colchicine_recurrence_percent.quote: the recurrence rate was 24% in the colchicine group

colchicine_events.why: The abstract gives a PERCENTAGE and no arm-level count. Multiplying 24% by an assumed 60 would be computing a cell from other cells, which is the one thing this extraction does not do.

colchicine_n.why: The abstract states 120 patients TOTAL and does not give the randomised split per arm. 60/60 is the obvious guess and is not stated. The full text is required.

total_randomised.quote: 120 patients with a first recurrence of pericarditis

trials.what_is_needed: Arm-level counts and denominators from the full text. Reported as missing rather than derived.

route_attempted_for_the_missing_cells.result: NO PMCID RETURNED. The full text is not in PubMed Central.
route_attempted_for_the_missing_cells.consequence: The arm-level counts and denominators CANNOT be resolved through any route available here. They remain NOT_STATED_IN_THE_SOURCE_READ. Obtaining them requires the publisher full text, which is outside what this lane can reach.
route_attempted_for_the_missing_cells.what_was_NOT_done: 60/60 was not assumed and 24% of 60 was not computed. An unreachable number is reported unreachable.

population_as_the_paper_states_it.quote: included 197 patients at high risk of tamponade ... at 7-30 days after cardiac surgery

primary_outcome_as_the_paper_states_it.value: change in pericardial effusion GRADE after 14-day treatment
primary_outcome_as_the_paper_states_it.quote: The main end point was change in pericardial effusion grade after 14-day treatment.
primary_outcome_as_the_paper_states_it.note: A CONTINUOUS echocardiographic grade, not a recurrence count. It shares no measurable endpoint with the other three whatever the population.

mean_difference_in_grade_decrease.quote: The mean difference in grade decrease between groups was -0.19 (95% CI -0.55 to 0.16, p=0.23)

trials.why_not: A continuous effusion GRADE is not a recurrence count. Different population, different construct, different measure.

what_is_NOT_done_here: NO POOL IS COMPUTED. Whether ICAP, CORP and CORP-2 may be combined across disease stage is a judgement that must be DECLARED on a named axis, not assumed from a title match -- and ICAP's endpoint additionally counts INCESSANT disease, which the other two do not. That is an estimand decision and it is owed separately.
